description: forkProcessing stays here because Renovate admits a fork before it reads the org-inherited config or resolves presets. This public repository loads the shared public preset; it cannot read the private org config.

packageRules.description: The code is written against @get-bb/plugin-sdk 0.6.54. Later npm releases no longer declare APIs it uses (experimental_useSidebarThreadPullRequest, openThreadPanel, openPanel, experimental_threadHeaderAction, goals), although the bb host still serves them, so a bump fails the type check and the UI tests. Move the SDK by hand together with the code that uses it.
